message:
There's a built `mruby` binary. Let me check if it has the instrumentation (the ASSERT_EVT prints) and test a simple script. Let me first understand the vulnerability better by examining the `mrb_funcall_argv` and how `to_a` triggers nested VM execution.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'echo "p [1,2] + [3]" | /gt/_work/src/bin/mruby 2>&1 | head -20'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
